# GitHub Copilot — Hospodar YKI

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as the canonical coding-agent policy, then [docs/INDEX.md](../docs/INDEX.md) to locate task-specific sources. This file intentionally does **not** maintain a second, drifting copy of architecture or test commands.

Current truth: browser `app/` = vanilla JS MVP; exam checkpoint = IndexedDB; LEARN = localStorage; Android Kotlin = uncompiled prototype. React/Vite/Phaser/Capacitor/PAD are target, not deployed. Preserve independent first-attempt evidence, fail-closed saves, privacy, Finnish content review and licensed media rules.

Use exact tests from [docs/TESTING.md](../docs/TESTING.md) and PR evidence from [the template](pull_request_template.md). Never report a command as PASS if it was not executed.

For engineering migration follow [Web/Android G1–G6 guide](../docs/guides/WEB-ANDROID-MIGRATION.md). For media, dictionaries or exercises use [authoring guide](../docs/guides/CONTENT-AUTHORING.md). CI path ownership and immutable action pins are in [operations guide](../docs/operations/CI-QUALITY-GATES.md).
